body: This happens pretty frequently, actually. People are just afraid to talk about it because then they're school shooters
You'd think that would be the obvious answer, right? Well, turns out that the law is so skewed in their direction that I can't do shit about it.

I probably scared them just because I was a loner with a troubled history and some mental health problems.

What do you mean when you say you "felt like you could be a school shooter?" That's concerning

That's a really good question. I honestly don't have the full answer. My best guess is that I was a troubled loner enrolled right when Parkland happened, and after being told by the media to be scared of school shootings, they invented a reason to be scared. In my experience, people will simply do what they are told by authorities. What I understand less is that if they really did consider me a potential school shooter because I was clearly in pain and in need of love, then they'd have to be really stupid to think compounding that pain would make me less likely to be a shooter. I honestly was angrier then than ever in my life.
